lines.arrive: Driving through the country, on a fine afternoon.
lines.flat: A flat tyre. Right beside a barn.
lines.tyre: Flat as a pancake. You'll be here a while.
lines.barn: A barn. Red, with white trim. You can see it as plainly as anything.
lines.true: And it is a barn. A real one.
lines.round: You walk all the way round it. Walls, a back, a roof, a silo. It's a barn.
lines.facades: But every other barn along this road is a front, propped up on sticks. From the road, you couldn't have told them apart. You just happened to look at the only real one.
lines.end: You believed it was a barn. It was. You had good reason. Did you know?
lines.facades_2: Every other barn along this road is only a front, propped up on sticks.
lines.end_2: But you went round the back. You could tell the real one from the fakes.
